title: Extend your Xcode Cloud workflows
description: Discover how Xcode Cloud can adapt to your development needs. We’ll show you how to streamline your workflows, automate testing and distribution with start conditions, custom aliases, custom scripts, webhooks, and the App Store Connect API.

codeSnippets.title: Custom Script
codeSnippets.code:
#!/bin/sh

set -e

if [[ $CI_XCODEBUILD_ACTION == "test-without-building" && $CI_WORKFLOW_ID == "82D89C93-B69C-46B5-A794-A2BCFD3EE487" ]]
then
    curl https://example.com/health --fail
fi
